actual: A newly added or modified test can satisfy file ownership and select a module CI plan while remaining absent from every selected nox session target list. Renaming the test to match an ownership wildcard therefore produces a false-green CI path: classification passes but the changed test is never collected. Require fail-closed proof that every changed test file is reachable from at least one selected executable CI plan, with explicit diagnostics and regression coverage.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
